name: Surge XT
pre_build: mkdir -p wasm-compat && printf '%s\n' '#pragma once' 'static inline int backtrace(void **b, int n) { (void)b; (void)n; return 0; }' 'static inline char **backtrace_symbols(void *const *b, int n) { (void)b; (void)n; return 0; }' 'static inline void backtrace_symbols_fd(void *const *b, int n, int fd) { (void)b; (void)n; (void)fd; }' > wasm-compat/execinfo.h

[ -f build-wasm/surge-libs.rsp ] || rm -rf build-wasm; [ -f build-wasm/surge-libs.rsp ] || ( emcmake cmake -S . -B build-wasm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-pthread -fPIC -fwasm-exceptions -isystem $PWD/wasm-compat" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-pthread -fPIC -fwasm-exceptions -DFMT_CONSTEVAL= -isystem $PWD/wasm-compat" > build-wasm.log 2>&1 && cmake --build build-wasm --target surge-common -j8 >> build-wasm.log 2>&1 && find build-wasm -name '*.a' | sort > build-wasm/surge-libs.list && (echo -Wl,--start-group; cat build-wasm/surge-libs.list; echo -Wl,--end-group) > build-wasm/surge-libs.rsp ) || (tail -60 build-wasm.log; exit 1)
[ -f build-wasm/CMakeFiles/surge-move-plugin.dir/src/dsp/surge_plugin.cpp.o ] || make -C build-wasm src/dsp/surge_plugin.cpp.o > build-wasm-plugin.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 build-wasm-plugin.log; exit 1)

rm -rf wasm-dist && mkdir -p wasm-dist/surge-data/patches_3rdparty && cp -r src/dsp/surge/resources/data/patches_factory wasm-dist/surge-data/ && rm -rf wasm-dist/surge-data/patches_factory/Tutorials wasm-dist/surge-data/patches_factory/Templates && cp -r 'src/dsp/surge/resources/data/patches_3rdparty/LinnStrument MPE' wasm-dist/surge-data/patches_3rdparty/ && cp -r src/dsp/surge/resources/data/wavetables wasm-dist/surge-data/ && cp src/dsp/surge/resources/surge-shared/configuration.xml wasm-dist/surge-data/
upstream_build: scripts/build.sh: cmake (CMakeLists.txt: Surge XT submodule, SURGE_SKIP_JUCE_FOR_RACK, SURGE_SKIP_LUA, block size 32) target surge-move-plugin -> dsp.so; dist/surge/{module.json,help.json,LICENSE,NOTICE,ui.js,dsp.so,surge-data/{patches_factory (minus Tutorials, Templates), patches_3rdparty/LinnStrument MPE, wavetables, configuration.xml}} (wasm: everything incl. surge_plugin.cpp is compiled by the upstream CMake via emcmake in pre_build; the recipe only links the side module)
wasm_notes: fmt 9 (Surge submodule) + clang 20 C++20 consteval format strings fail to compile; built with -DFMT_CONSTEVAL= (disables compile-time format checks only). No <execinfo.h> in Emscripten: pre_build writes a no-op backtrace() stub header (sst-plugininfra misc_linux.cpp crash-handler only). REQUIRES C++ EXCEPTIONS: Surge's init/patch DB/std::filesystem code relies on try/catch, so it is built with -fwasm-exceptions, and the main module (engine, test host) must also be built and linked with -fwasm-exceptions (EH-enabled libc++abi). With the default no-exceptions main module the side module will not link at dlopen. Patches: 0001 (MTS-ESP static ctors call dlopen -> deadlock on Emscripten's non-recursive dlopen lock), 0002 (no dladdr on Emscripten).
